subject: [PATCH 09/16] selftests/mm: skip khugepaged swap tests when no swap is configured

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged selftests to skip swap tests when no swap area is configured on the system. The test checks if there is a swap area by reading /proc/swaps, and if not, it skips the tests that rely on MADV_PAGEOUT functionality. This prevents spurious failures due to missing swap devices. The patch adds a new function has_swap() to check for the presence of a swap area and uses this function in the collapse_swapin_single_pte and collapse_max_ptes_swap functions to skip the tests when no swap is configured.
